card.name: Words before partition coefficients and binding
card.fires_on: Small linking or describing words (and, to, on, of, high, low) right before an expected term like log Kow, distribution coefficient, or protein binding. The setting is chemical partitioning or drug binding.

modes.description: A small word such as and, on, to or of just before a partitioning or distribution term in environmental text.
